10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

4489|d4f863ac.name: Braug Dimspirit
4489|d4f863ac.text: Greetings, $c. Is there something I can help you with?

4489|d9f65c9b.name: Braug Dimspirit
4489|d9f65c9b.text:
My question to you is this, $c:
Which of the Aspects created by the titans became the nefarious creature known as Deathwing?

1151-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-accept.text:
During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.

There are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.

To test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.
1151-accept.title: Test of Strength

1151-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-complete.text: The Test of Strength is done. You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.
1151-complete.title: Test of Strength

1151-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-progress.text: Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.
1151-progress.title: Test of Strength

1152-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1152-accept.text:
Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of $N is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.

If you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $N.

When you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $N, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
1152-accept.title: Test of Lore

1152-complete.name: Braug Dimspirit
1152-complete.text:
The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.

Now you stand before Braug.
1152-complete.title: Test of Lore

1154-accept.name: Braug Dimspirit
1154-accept.text:
You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.

I shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.

What book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.
1154-accept.title: Test of Lore

1154-complete.name: Braug Dimspirit
1154-complete.text:
This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.

When you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.
1154-complete.title: Test of Lore

1154-progress.name: Braug Dimspirit
1154-progress.text: Bring me the book after you've studied it. I will not ask you your question until after you have given me the book.
1154-progress.title: Test of Lore

1159-accept.name: Braug Dimspirit
1159-accept.text:
Well done, $N. You have passed the first portion of the Test of $N, but there is still another question to be answered. But that question is not mine to ask.

Seek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.

He will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.
1159-accept.title: Test of Lore

4904-accept.name: Lakota Windsong
4904-accept.text:
Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here.  My poor brother...

$N, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle?  Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.
4904-accept.title: Free at Last

4904-complete.name: Thalia Amberhide
4904-complete.text: Thank you, $N. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.
4904-complete.title: Free at Last

5064-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-complete.text:
Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.

$N, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
5064-complete.title: Grimtotem Spying

5064-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-progress.text: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?
5064-progress.title: Grimtotem Spying

5147-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-complete.text:
Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!

Here you are, $N... and thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!
5147-complete.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

5147-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
5147-progress.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

6627-accept.name: Braug Dimspirit
6627-accept.text:
You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?

Time is not an issue, $c, so do not feel pressured. You may take as long as you like to answer.
6627-accept.title: Test of Lore

6627-complete.name: Braug Dimspirit
6627-complete.text: Well done, $c. You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.
6627-complete.title: Test of Lore

96260-accept.name: Steel
96260-accept.text:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260-accept.title: Stronger than Steel

96261-accept.name: Steel
96261-accept.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261-accept.title: The Broodmother
